connector.name: The-Snip
connector.registryDescription: Team knowledge base for snippets, API calls and docs. Agents search and file items; humans review.
connector.summary: Hosted at the-snip.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.the-snip, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Workspace API key as a Bearer token. Generate one in Settings → API keys — keys are free on every plan, no card required. Reads are free on every plan: any agent can search the base. Every Free workspace also gets 5 free agent writes (lifetime); each one lands in the review queue for a human to approve. Unlimited agent writes are part of Pro & Team ($8/user/mo). Format: Bearer snip_...
